title: Pandacorp design-freeze fidelity config
description: docs/design/freeze/fidelity.config.json: drives every fidelity tool (split + tokens, measure, shard, screens, catalog, identity, diff) and is read by preflight-round.mjs (preflight) and check-design-gate.mjs (widths, themes, states, validated against this file). Paths are relative to the project root. Validated by config.mjs against this file (a JSON-Schema subset: type, enum, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, minItems, minimum, maximum, minProperties, maxProperties, $ref).

prototype.description: The frozen whole-app prototype, e.g. docs/design/prototype/app.html.

lang.description: lang attribute of the generated pages (default en).

touchBelow.description: Widths below this are touch phones: isMobile + hasTouch + hover:none + pointer:coarse (default 768).

themes.description: Themes (default [light, dark]); each is passed as the theme URL param and as prefers-color-scheme when it is light or dark.

themeAttribute.description: <html> attribute the prototype stores its theme in; the generated pages' theme toggle flips it (default data-theme).

params.description: URL params added to every prototype URL. An empty string disables one.

host.description: Normal-page host mode, so a grown viewport does not switch on an auto-height frame mode (default host=page).

theme.description: Name of the theme param (default theme).

hostAutoClass.description: Class on <html> that means the prototype switched to its auto-height host mode; any capture taken with it fails (default host-auto; null disables the check).

baseHeight.description: Viewport height between captures and of viewport-only captures (default 900).

workers.description: P: parallel browser workers (default 4; env FIDELITY_WORKERS and --workers override).

hashNavigation.description: A warm page whose document is unchanged moves to the next route by setting location.hash instead of reloading (default true).

waitMs.description: Fixed wait after fonts and images (default 500).

imageTimeoutMs.description: Longest wait for images (default 8000); a visible image still not decoded then fails the run.

scrollPass.description: Also scroll the page top to bottom once (for scroll-triggered content; default false, lazy images are forced eager instead).

probe.description: Page expressions recorded with every capture.

demoOff.description: JS expression true when the demo scaffolding is off; when set, a capture where it is false fails.

theme.description: JS expression returning the rendered theme (default: the themeAttribute of <html>).

screens.description: Whole-app screens. A string is a screen id routed as #id. Omitted: every <tag screenAttribute=id> of the prototype not marked demoOnlyAttribute.

screenSelector.description: Selector of the screen containers; the visible one is the screen a mock shows (default 'main > [data-screen]').

sprite.description: Regex (source) matching the icon sprite in the prototype HTML, inlined into mocks and the catalogue (default: the first <svg> with width=0 and height=0; null: no sprite).

prefix.description: File prefix of the whole-app screenshots (default: the prototype file name without extension).

css.description: How split-css.mjs files the prototype's <style> rules. Without families/rules every rule is filed by the heuristic.

numbered.description: Prefix each file with its two-digit load position, NN-<family>.css (default true).

note.description: Extra header line of the file.

component.description: The component(s) of docs/design/components.md this file styles (README table).

rules.description: Classification, first match wins: the regex is tested against the key selector (first selector of the prelude, prefixStrip removed; an @keyframes prelude is its own key).

overrides.description: Normalised prelude (a wrapper: its prelude + ' { ' + its first rule's prelude) -> family. Checked first; a wrapper listed here is kept whole.

prefixStrip.description: Regex (source) of context prefixes removed from a key selector before matching (default: html, :root, theme and host-mode prefixes).

verbatim.description: Blocks copied line for line into one family, delimited by comments containing begin/end.

pendingCommentsTo.description: Family that receives the comments still pending when the block starts (default: the block's family).

closingComments.description: A top-level comment containing `contains` closes a block and is filed in `family` (other comments travel with the next rule).

unmatched.description: A rule no family claims: filed by the heuristic (default) or a hard failure.

states.description: Per UI FRD (its docs/frds/<frd> folder name): every state its mock shows, in order.

extras.description: Open overlays shown below the screen in a mock (default: dialog[open]).

strip.description: Selector of demo-only markup removed from every mock (default [demoOnlyAttribute]).

gateAttributes.description: Session-gating attributes: an element carrying one is dropped when hidden, else the attribute is removed.

htmlAttributes.description: Attributes of the mock pages' <html> (default {themeAttribute: light}).

components.description: Components measured into computed-styles.json, in catalogue order.

floating.description: Floating panels whose box offset from their anchor is recorded (anchor_offset).

panel.description: '$' the root, '$ sel' inside it, 'doc:sel' in the document.

mode.description: pareto (default): every state at the primary width light; layout states at the touch width; dark records carry the colour properties only (every state at the primary width, the default state at the touch width); component images at the touch and primary widths light plus dark for the default state. full: every state x width x theme, every property, every image.

sheetMax.description: Tallest catalogue sheet before it is cut into parts (default 30000).

attempts.description: Fresh capture pairs a screen gets to come out identical (default 3).

maxRatio.description: Largest share of differing pixels per slice (default 0.005).

exports.description: JS expression evaluated in the prototype returning {relativePath: content}: exact SVG assets written next to the prototype by the catalog stage.

tokens.description: How the split stage groups the extracted custom properties in docs/design/design-tokens.json (tokens.mjs).

groups.description: Checked first, first match wins: a token whose name matches the regex goes to this group. Unmatched tokens fall back to the built-in name prefixes (typography, space, radius, stroke, zIndex, motion, elevation, brand, color), then a colour value, then the first name segment.

preflight.description: Thresholds of preflight-round.mjs (the per-round prototype contract check). The mock widths and themes the design gate requires are the top-level widths/themes (a state's own widths narrows them), not a key here.

textWidths.description: Widths the text-size and demo-leak checks render at (default [375, 1280]).

demoSelectors.description: Demo scaffolding that must be hidden under demo=off (default [data-demo-only], .demo-badge, .demo-controls, .demo-strip).

demoText.description: Regex (source, case-insensitive) of visible demo wording that must not render under demo=off.

maxLiteralColors.description: Colour literals allowed outside the token blocks (default 0).

maxLiteralLengths.description: px length literals allowed outside the token blocks before a warning (default 150).

smallTextIgnore.description: Selectors exempt from the text-size floor (the poster block's own classes are exempt automatically).

action.description: One step: click (a real pointer click), domClick (element.click(), reaches hidden elements), fill [selector, value] (real typing), wait (ms), waitFor (selector that must become visible), scroll (y or selector), removeAttr [selector, name], setAttr [selector, name, value], js (page code).

capture.description: viewport: an overlay or a popover that closes on scroll or resize; the page is settled before the actions and shot without growing or scrolling.

componentState.description: force [[target, [pseudo...]]] (CDP CSS.forcePseudoState), attr [[target, name, value|null]], cls [[target, class, on]], js (page code), click (a real click; '$ sel' inside the root), spre (page code after the click), scroll (y), route (another URL), root (another root), wait (ms, default 450), widths, layout (true: measured at the touch width under pareto; default: false for a state made only of forced pseudo-classes).

root.description: Selector of the component root (the first visible match).

children.description: Key descendants ('doc:' = anywhere in the document). Omitted: up to 6 descendants with distinct first classes.

pre.description: Page code run before every state.

show.description: Ancestor selector shown in the catalogue and the crops instead of the bare root.
